$comment: Every outbound link in content, data and rendered HTML must resolve to a host on this list. Categories: regulators and governments, law databases, literature indexes and DOI resolver, universities and public research institutes, anti-doping bodies, patient/harm-reduction/professional bodies, journals (reached via doi.org wherever possible). Adding a host requires a reason in the 'why' field. Commercial suppliers of any medicine or peptide are never eligible.

suffixes.why: EU institutions (EMA, EUR-Lex, European Commission, CTIS)

Australian Commonwealth, state and territory government (TGA, Federal Register of Legislation, PBS, Border Force, Office of Drug Control, state health departments and legislation, healthdirect, Ahpra)
New Zealand government (Medsafe, Health New Zealand, Ministry of Health, New Zealand Legislation, NZ Gazette)
Government of Canada departments and agencies (Justice Laws Website, Canada Border Services Agency, Health Canada databases)
Government of Canada web domain (canada.ca, Health Canada recalls and safety alerts, Drug Product Database, Canadian Clinical Trial Search Portal)
Health Products Regulatory Authority, Ireland's medicines regulator (incl. its side-effect reporting form and its short address online-medicine-safety.hpra.ie)
Health Service Executive, Ireland's public health service
NHS organisations in England and Wales (incl. NHS 111 Wales)
